name: @discere-os/glib.wasm
description: High-performance GLib foundation library with WebAssembly, SIMD optimizations, and TypeScript-first API

imports.module: data:application/javascript,export const createRequire = () => (id) => { if (id === 'path') return { dirname: () => '', join: (...args) => args.join('/') }; if (id === 'url') return { fileURLToPath: (url) => url.replace('file://', '') }; if (id === 'fs') return { readFileSync: () => { throw new Error('fs not supported'); } }; throw new Error(`Module ${id} not found`); }; export default { createRequire };
imports.path: data:application/javascript,export const dirname = () => ''; export const join = (...args) => args.join('/'); export default { dirname, join };
imports.url: data:application/javascript,export const fileURLToPath = (url) => url.replace('file://', ''); export default { fileURLToPath };
imports.fs: data:application/javascript,export const readFileSync = () => { throw new Error('fs not supported'); }; export default { readFileSync };
imports.os: data:application/javascript,export const platform = () => 'browser'; export const arch = () => 'wasm32'; export default { platform, arch };

tasks.build: deno task build:wasm && deno task build:types
tasks.build:main: PKG_CONFIG_PATH=$PWD/../libffi.wasm/install/wasm/pkgconfig meson setup build-main --cross-file=scripts/emscripten.cross -Ddefault_library=static -Dxattr=false -Dtests=false --force-fallback-for=libpcre2-8 -Dbuildtype=release --prefix=$PWD/install -Dlibdir=wasm -Dbindir=wasm && meson compile -C build-main glib-main && mkdir -p install/wasm && cp build-main/wasm/glib-main.js build-main/wasm/glib-main.wasm install/wasm/
tasks.build:side: PKG_CONFIG_PATH=$PWD/../libffi.wasm/install/wasm/pkgconfig meson setup build-side --cross-file=scripts/emscripten.cross -Ddefault_library=static -Dxattr=false -Dtests=false --force-fallback-for=libpcre2-8 -Dbuildtype=release --prefix=$PWD/install -Dlibdir=wasm -Dbindir=wasm && meson compile -C build-side glib-side && mkdir -p install/wasm && cp build-side/wasm/glib-side.so install/wasm/glib-side.wasm
tasks.build:wasm: deno task build:main && deno task build:side && deno task manifest
tasks.build:all: deno task build:wasm && deno task build:npm
tasks.publish:npm: deno task build:all && cd npm && npm publish
tasks.publish:dry: deno task build:all && cd npm && npm publish --dry-run
tasks.clean: rm -rf build-* dist/ install/ npm/ && echo '✅ Cleaned all build artifacts'
tasks.check:all: deno check src/lib/index.ts && deno check demo-deno.ts && deno check bench/glib.bench.ts && deno check _build_npm.ts
